posts.text:
When someone says the US obesity rate is 40%+ people get upset, bring up outliers, and talk about how BMI is 'inaccurate'.

So recently, doctors suggested a new measure that also considers waist circumference, waist hip ratio, and body fat scans.

It estimates 70% are obese lol.
